title: Mini-Project: Calculator
concept: Build a simple arithmetic calculator that demonstrates functions, control flow, variables, and output — everything from Levels 0 and 1.
why: This project ties together 50 lessons of learning. Building something real solidifies your knowledge and shows you how concepts work together.
tips: Break the problem into small functions — each does ONE thing
Handle edge cases: what if someone divides by zero?
Use tail expressions for simple returns — cleaner code
common_mistakes: Trying to write everything in main() — use functions!
Forgetting to handle division by zero
Not testing with different inputs (positive, negative, zero)
